messages:
Maya (Design): dropped a new prototype for a compact history row that includes a mini-scrubber + quick-reinstate affordance. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-mini-timeline
Maya (Design): question for the group: should we label the action 'Reinstate' or 'Rollback undo'? trying to avoid jargon.
Arjun (PM): prefer 'Reinstate' — clearer to product folks. maybe add helper text: 'Reinstate will set this version live again.'
Noah (Eng-Frontend): Reinstate works. Implementation note: mini-scrubber will be interactive (hover shows snapshot tooltip). keyboard: scrubber must be focusable and arrow-key adjustable.
Zoe (Accessibility): tooltip on hover isn't enough. when focused, expose the snapshot summary via aria-describedby and provide an option to open the full diff. Also ensure scrubber uses aria-valuetext like 'version v5.2.3 — deployed 2h ago'.
Priya (Eng-Backend): backend needs snapshot metadata for each version. we keep last 5 snapshots for now; reinstates will reference snapshot_id. can add TTL of 24h, configurable per org.
Ben (ProductOps): Ops asks for a quick 'why reinstated' input on confirm modal — short comment field to populate audit logs.
Maya (Design): good call. UX: small optional text area in modal, placeholder 'brief reason (optional)'.
Arjun (PM): another UX decision: allow soft rollback (traffic shift back to previous variant) vs full reinstate (flip active version). we should show consequences.
Noah (Eng-Frontend): propose two-row modal with radio: ( ) Soft rollback — shift traffic back over 15 min, ( ) Full reinstate — immediate swap. add a small inline cost/impact summary.
Zoe (Accessibility): radio group needs a clear label and keyboard grouping. When the action is started, announce status updates via aria-live. For progressive actions, use role=status and update text like 'Shifting traffic: 20%...'.
Priya (Eng-Backend): backend will support both: endpoint param mode:soft|full, and canary_duration_ms. rate-limit reinstates per deployment to avoid churn.
Maya (Design): copy suggestions for modal title: 'Reinstate previous version' and confirm button copy: 'Reinstate v5.2.3'. cancel button 'Keep current'.
Ben (ProductOps): include link in the modal to 'View audit trail' that opens the deployment details behind the modal.
Noah (Eng-Frontend): for the row, propose an overflow kebab with 'Reinstate' + 'Preview diff' + 'Open details'. If keyboard-only, kebab should be reachable as first-action not visually.
Zoe (Accessibility): ensure kebab menu has an accessible name and that menu items have unique labels (don't duplicate 'Reinstate' and 'Reinstate version'). use clear labels: 'Reinstate v5.2.3 (undo rollback)'.
Maya (Design): visual nit: mini-scrubber ticks should indicate canary breakpoints (10%, 50%, 100%). need legend.
Noah (Eng-Frontend): can render ticks via CSS small markers. also add a compact numeric label next to the scrubber for screen readers.
Priya (Eng-Backend): for previews, we'll provide a diff-summary endpoint deployments/:id/diff-summary which returns text-only highlights so previews are cheap. limit to 1 request per 2s per session.
Maya (Design): empty states microcopy: 'No recent rollouts. Try widening the date range or remove filters.' also add CTA 'Show last 7 days'.
Ben (ProductOps): add saved views support: teams can save filter+sort as a named view. very helpful for on-call.
Noah (Eng-Frontend): saved views: persist in user settings + org default. will need small API for CRUD. keyboard shortcut idea: press '/' to jump to search, '?' to open shortcuts list.
Zoe (Accessibility): avoid using single-letter shortcuts without modifiers. prefer '?' for help, but confirm with international keyboard layouts. provide an on-screen legend for shortcuts.
Maya (Design): adding a11y checklist item: focus order for row -> actions -> modal -> audit link. also include visible focus indicators.
Arjun (PM): action items: Maya update figma + modal copy (task D-2491), Noah implement accessible scrubber spike, Priya add diff-summary endpoint + snapshot TTL config, Zoe produce accessibility checklist, Ben spec saved views requirements.
Maya (Design): ETA: will upload new frames by EOD and tag handoff layers.
Noah (Eng-Frontend): spike ETA: 2 days.
Priya (Eng-Backend): spike ETA: 3 days for summary + TTL.
Zoe (Accessibility): checklist draft by tomorrow morning.
Ben (ProductOps): I'll draft saved-views use cases for release notes and on-call docs.
design-bot: Uploaded image 'mini-timeline-scrubber.png' (preview)
Maya (Design): thanks all — closing thread but will reopen once figma is updated. :white_check_mark:
